title: The Year at Home
tagline: Lockdowns, video calls and a world working from the kitchen table.

locale.persona: a family working and schooling from home in an apartment

morningRoutine.detail: After the national emergency was declared on March 13 and states issued stay-at-home orders, many people worked from home.

futureVisions.prediction: Employees who can work from home may continue to do so "forever".
futureVisions.note: Hybrid work stuck for many office jobs, though many companies later called staff back.

source.label: InsideHook, 13 May 2020: Jack Dorsey says Twitter employees can work from home 'forever'

futureVisions.prediction: The program will produce and deliver 300 million doses of safe and effective vaccines, with the first doses available by January 2021.
futureVisions.whoSaidIt: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Operation Warp Speed (announced May 15, 2020)
futureVisions.note: The first doses came early, on December 14, 2020, but 100 million doses had been given only by March 2021.

source.label: Wikipedia: Operation Warp Speed
